name: deckide
description: Deck IDE - Browser-based shell workspace with decks and terminals

scripts.build: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.test:terminal:unit: node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/terminal-tmux-adapter.test.ts tests/terminal-snapshot.test.mjs tests/terminal-frame.test.ts tests/terminal-websocket-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/terminal-reconnect.test.ts tests/terminal-queries.test.ts
scripts.test:terminal:all: node --import tsx --experimental-vm-modules --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/terminal-frame.test.ts tests/terminal-queries.test.ts tests/terminal-reconnect.test.ts tests/terminal-snapshot.test.mjs tests/terminal-tmux-adapter.test.ts tests/terminal-websocket-lifecycle.test.mjs tests/terminal-tmux-broker.test.mjs tests/terminal-tmux-live.test.mjs tests/session-auth.test.mjs tests/cli-auth.test.mjs tests/terminal-update-guards.test.mjs
scripts.build:vnc-candidate: npm run build:server && npm run build:vnc-launcher
